verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Open WebUI publishes an llms.txt at docs.openwebui.com that returns HTTP 200 and describes itself as a curated, machine-readable index of every docs page. Docs pages are also served as raw Markdown (e.g. reference/api-endpoints.md), so an agent can be pointed at them directly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/agent-docs offering and how to use it, and evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt) beyond the index.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Machine-readable entry points to this documentation:
/llms.txt - curated index of every docs page
